Study on water harvsesting and
storage schemes
*121. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
Will the Minister of WATER
RESOURCES  be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government had made any
studies on water harvesting and storage
schemes in Rajasthan and U.P. during the
Ninth Five Year Plan period; and
(b) if so, the number of projects approved
as a result thereof?
National Bibliographic data-base in
libraries
*122. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA : Will
the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that preparation of
National Bibliographic data-base in
electronic format has been completed in
Indian Libraries;
(b) the details of libraries in the country
in which the above work is going on;
(c) whether any time-frame has been
fixed to complete the project; and
(d) if so, the details of the time-frame
and budget required to complete the project?
Modernisation of airports
*123. SHRI ASHWANI KUMAR: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the new developments and
modernisation at various airports in the
country are proceeding as per schedule; if
so, the details thereof;
(b) whether Government have finalised
a regulatory and legal framework for
Airports management and development
consistent with the future needs of the
country; and
(c) whether any particular country's
experience has been taken as a model
framework for modernisation and
upgradation of airport infrastructure in the
country?
Unclaimed deposit in HDFC
†*124. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Housing Development

Recovery of NPAs of Punjab National
Bank
*125. SHRI K. KALAVEN KATA
RAO: Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Punjab National Bank has
given powers to its zonal managers to
recover non-performing assets under a new
one-time settlement scheme;
(b) if so, the main features of the scheme;
(c) whether this scheme is proposed to
be introduced in other banks also; and
(d) whether defaulters will be given any
benefit under this scheme?
ONGC's new investment
*126. SHRI VAYALAR RAVI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a)  whether Oil and Natural Gas
Corporation Limited plans to invest
Rs. 16,200 crore on its upstream business
for the financial year 2003-2004;
(b) if so, whether this will be 47 per cent
higher as compared to the last year;
(c) if so, to what extent it will help to
reduce the import bill; and
(d) what are the main projects on which
this amount will be spent?
Capital market reforms
*127. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
SHRI RUMANDLA RAAMA-
CHANDRAYYA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) the steps proposed to be taken as part
of capital market reforms; and
(b) the other steps proposed to be taken
to facilitate corporatisation of Stock
Exchanges?
Development of tourism infrastructure
in Tamil Nadu
*128. SHRI S.P.M. SYED KHAN: Will
the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether any project has been
sanctioned for the development of Tourism
infrastructure in Tamil Nadu during the
Tenth Five Year Plan;
(b) if so, the details of the project with
financial allocation; and
(c) the State-wise number of projects
completed during the last three years?
Cargo theft at IGI Airport
†*129. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are incurring financial losses due to theft  of
cargo being sent abroad from Indira Gandhi
International Airport;
(b) if so, the details of losses incurred
during the last three years; and

RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the July 29, 2003/Sravana 7, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Civil Aviation; Finance; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism
and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—155
Air services among the capitals of
NE States
872. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any plan
to introduce air services among the
capitals of the North-Eastern States;
(b) whether Government have been
thinking of increasing the airbus and
boeing services between Agartala and
Kolkata and of decreasing Air services,
considering the geographically isolated
location of Tripura; and
(c) the details of the network
programme of the Indian Airlines for the
N.E. region?
X-ray machines at airports in
Madhya Pradesh
†873. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether X-ray machines for
checking of luggage from security point
of view are available at all the airports of
Madhya Pradesh;
(b) whether these machines are out of
order at many airports;
(c) if so, since when; and
(d) what steps Government are taking
for ensuring the safety aspect?
Operation of new aircrafts
874. SHRI SURESH KALMADI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have finalised
the details to acquire new Aircrafts for
Indian Airlines and Air India recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when they will be ready for
operational purposes?
Study on traffic growth
875. DR. VIJAY MALLYA:
SHRI PRAFUL PATEL:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) the total strength of aircrafts
owned and operated by Indian Airlines
at present;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

192
WIN2\SESSION\1756RS 192
(b) the number of aircrafts which have
outlived their normal lives and require
replacement;
(c) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering a proposal for purchase
of 43 aircrafts at a cost of Rs. 10,000
crores instead of obtaining them on wet/
dry lease;
(d) whether any study on traffic
growth has been undertaken which
would justify purchase of these aircrafts
instead of taking them on wet/dry lease;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Commission to sales agents of Air
India
†876. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Air India
has suffered huge loss due to commission
given arbitrarily to its sales agents by
three senior officers of its London-based
office;
(b) if so, the amount of loss suffered
by Air India;
(c) whether it is also a fact that a
penalty has been imposed on these
officers after declaring them guilty by
C.B.I.;
(d) if so, the amount of the penalty
imposed and by when it will be recovered;
and
(e) what are the recommendations of
the Parliamentary Committee in this
regard?
Expansion of Bhubaneswar Airport
877. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the airport
at Bhubaneswar is proposed to be
expanded;
(b) if so, whether the central
Government would meet its expenses;
(c) whether it is proposed to set up an
International Airport in Orissa, keeping
in view its heritage character; and
(d) whether any kind of facilities are
proposed to be provided at the airports in
the State to boost tourism, especially
foreign tourists?
Losses to IA on unviable routes
878. SHRIMATI JAMANA DEVI
BARUPAL:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines is paying
a heavy price for continuing to operate
on seemingly unviable routes;
(b) if so, whether a look at the airlines
annual report for 2001-2002 shows that
as many as 24 of the 70 domestic services
operated by the airline during that year
did not meet even the direct (cash) cost
of operations;
(c) if so, what steps Government
propose to take to improve the situation;
(d) whether any concrete proposals in
this regard have been worked out for
2002-2003 and 2003-2004; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Purchase of aircrafts from Airbus
Industry
879. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA
RAO:
SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
SHRI THANGA TAMIL
SELVAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to refer to the answer to
Unstarred Question 4042 given in the
Rajya Sabha on 29th April, 2003 and state:
(a) whether Indian Airlines's proposal
to purchase new aircrafts worth more than
Rs. 10,000 crores from Airbus Industry
has since been cleared by Public
Investment Board (PIB);
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons for selecting Airbus
Industry only for purchase of aircrafts
when other companies like Boeing are
offering State-of-the-art aircrafts?
